inspiration: Shot chance is a function of range and of whether the defender can see the shooter; a shot the player cannot see is more accurate, and a running player makes shots harder (WL_ACT2.C T_Shoot, line 3444). Keep 'visible means dodgeable'; change it to a telegraph timer.
Shooter classes count range differently: the SS and boss classes use a shorter effective range (WL_ACT2.C lines 3461-3462). Keep a per-class accuracy curve; change the curve.
Attack state chain: a shooting state that fires on the middle frame and then returns to chase (WL_ACT2.C line 431). Windup, release, recover for rows 4 and 7.
Walk/chase cycle from four frames with one-frame holds between pairs (WL_ACT2.C lines 434-439). The hold beat reads as a pause at 375 wide.
Death: the scream fires on the first frame of the death chain, then a four-frame fall that holds its last frame (WL_ACT2.C lines 441-444). Sound on frame one; the body stays readable.
Difficulty as a column: one hit-point table with four rows, one per difficulty (WL_ACT2.C line 42). Data-first shape for row 21 and row 22.
Dog leap: five frames with the bite on frame two (WL_ACT2.C line 511). Telegraphed lunge for a row-7 clip.
Ghost hover: two frames, no ground contact (WL_ACT2.C line 460). Translucent pursuer reads as a threat without a new model.
Projectile chain: a rocket state that spawns a smoke-puff chain, then a three-frame boom (WL_ACT2.C lines 181-189). Effects as state chains are data.
